targetReport.title: Market Absorption Survey
targetReport.description: CMHC's monthly survey of newly completed homeowner and condominium units in Census Metropolitan Areas of 100,000 or more, enumerated until fully sold, with sales prices collected where possible. It is carried out with the Starts and Completions Survey, and the two share one methodology page, which is this node's url. Its sales values weight Statistics Canada's NHPI. Minted 2026-10-17.

results.bestSpan: Sales values for singles, semis and row houses collected from the Canada Mortgage and Housing Corporation's Market Absorption Survey provide the weights
results.window: The price data, reported for all models from the sample of builders, are assigned equal weight in the calculation of the contractors' selling price index for each city. Sales values for singles, semis and row houses collected from the Canada Mortgage and Housing Corporation's Market Absorption Survey provide the weights used to aggregate indexes for the CMAs up to the regional, provincial and national levels. Separate weights are estimated annually for the house component, the land component and the total for each city.
